headline: Arsenal have business reasons for job losses, but it symbolises the bleak reality of how football is run
body: Arsenal are planning to make 60 staff redundant. The argument is always that businesses have to make tough decisions, and sometimes that means people losing their jobs. But even if you subscribe to that cold assessment of the situation, the key words are ‘have to’.   submitted by   /u/TheAthletic [link]   [comments]
